apps.policy_text:
Bitcoin Explorer Privacy Policy
Last updated: November 19, 2026

Bitcoin Explorer ("the App") is an Android application that lets users view Bitcoin network information, such as blocks, transactions, addresses, fees, and mining statistics. The App is developed by Labs Dev Apps ("we", "us", "our").

This Privacy Policy explains what information the App handles and how it is used.

1. Information We Do Not Collect

We do not operate user accounts and we do not ask you to register. The App does not collect your name, email address, phone number, postal address, contacts, photos, or precise location. We do not hold, request, or store private keys, seed phrases, or wallet balances. The App is not a wallet.

2. Data Stored on Your Device

The following data is stored locally on your device only and is not sent to us:

Favorites (addresses, transactions, blocks you save)
Recent searches
Transactions you choose to track
Wallet addresses you choose to track
App settings (theme, amount unit)

You can delete this data at any time from Settings ("Delete local data") or by clearing the App's storage or uninstalling the App.

3. Network Requests to Blockchain Data Services

To show Bitcoin network data, the App sends requests to public blockchain data services (the mempool.space public API, and Blockstream as a backup source). When you search for or open an address, transaction, or block, or when tracking is active, the identifier you entered (for example an address, transaction ID, or block number) is sent to these services together with technical information that any internet request includes, such as your IP address. We do not receive or store this information. These services have their own privacy policies and practices.

Bitcoin addresses, transactions, and blocks are public information on the Bitcoin blockchain.

4. Notifications

If you choose to track a transaction or wallet, the App checks its status periodically and can show a local notification on your device. Notifications are created on your device. Tracking works while the App is open or running in the background and may be delayed if the system restricts background activity.

5. Advertising (Google AdMob)

The App shows ads provided by Google AdMob. The App may display banner ads, interstitial ads, and app open ads.

To serve and measure ads, Google and its partners may collect and use certain data from your device, such as your advertising ID, IP address, device and app information, and ad interaction data. This may be used to show personalized or non-personalized ads, to limit how often you see an ad, to measure ad performance, and to prevent fraud and abuse. We do not receive your personal information from this process.

You can learn how Google uses data from apps that use its services at https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites

Consent (EEA, UK, and other regions): Where required by law, the App shows a consent form (Google User Messaging Platform) before ads are requested. You can change your choice later using "Ad privacy settings" in the App's Settings, when that option is available for your region.

Ad controls: You can reset your advertising ID or opt out of ad personalization in your Android device settings (Settings > Privacy > Ads, or Settings > Google > Ads).

6. Permissions

Internet: to load Bitcoin network data and ads.
Notifications: to show alerts for tracked transactions and wallets (you can decline this permission).
Advertising ID: used by the advertising service described above.

7. Data Sharing

We do not sell your personal information. The only data leaving your device is the network requests described in Sections 3 and 5, which go to the third-party services named there.

8. Data Security

We take reasonable measures to protect data handled by the App, and data stays on your device unless described above. However, no method of electronic storage or transmission is completely secure. Please do not rely on the App to store sensitive information.

9. Children's Privacy

The App is not directed to children under 13 (or the minimum age required in your country), and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided personal information through the App, contact us and we will address it.

10. Financial Information Disclaimer

The App shows information from public data sources, including price information in USD. It is provided for informational purposes only and is not financial, investment, tax, or legal advice. Data may be delayed or inaccurate.

11. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be published on this page and the "Last updated" date will be revised.

12. Contact

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or the App, you can contact us.

App: Bitcoin Explorer
Developer: Labs Dev Apps
Email: labsdevapps@gmail.com

apps.policy_text:
RunPad Privacy Policy
Last updated: November 19, 2026

RunPad ("the App") is an Android application that allows users to write code, create files and projects, run code, and view the results on their mobile devices.

This Privacy Policy explains how RunPad handles user data.

1. Data We Collect

RunPad is not designed to directly collect users' personal information or send it to servers.

The following data may be created or stored on your device as part of the App:

Code files created by the user
Project files and folders
App settings
Selected app language
Temporary output and console data generated while running code

This data may be processed on your device to provide the core functions of the App.

2. Personal Information

RunPad does not collect the following personal information on its own servers:

First name
Last name
Email address
Phone number
Address
Contacts
Photos
Location data

3. Files and Code

RunPad may use files created by the user or added to the App on the device in order to provide code editing, project management, preview, and code execution features.

Code written by the user and project files created by the user are not automatically sent to the developer as part of the normal operation of the App.

4. Code Execution

RunPad uses local runtime environments to run or display code written in supported technologies such as HTML, JavaScript, Python, Java, PHP, C, and SQL on the device.

Output and temporary data generated during code execution may be processed on the device to perform the App's functions.

5. Internet Use

RunPad's core code editing and code execution features are designed to work on the device wherever possible.

User code running inside the App may perform actions that require an internet connection. For example, an HTML/JavaScript project created by the user may try to access an external web resource.

Such connections are made as required by the code or content the user runs, not by RunPad itself.

6. WebView Use

RunPad may use Android WebView technology to preview and run HTML and web-based projects.

Content created by the user may run inside WebView. Websites or external resources may have their own privacy policies and data practices.

7. Third-Party Services

RunPad does not use a mandatory online account system that sends user data to the developer for its core functions.

Third-party Android or runtime components used by the App may process data according to their own technical requirements. The data practices of these components are subject to the policies of their respective providers.

8. Data Security

Reasonable technical measures are taken to protect user data.

However, no method of electronic storage or data transmission can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

Users are advised not to store sensitive information in code files or project files.

9. Children's Privacy

RunPad does not knowingly collect personal information from children.

The App does not include a registration system that requires submitting personal information.

10. User Responsibility

Users are responsible for the content of the code, files, and projects they create.

Users should take appropriate security measures when storing passwords, API keys, credentials, or other sensitive information in code files.

11. Changes to This Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy may be updated when necessary.

Changes will be published on this page and the "Last updated" date will be revised.

12. Contact

If you have questions about RunPad or this Privacy Policy, you can contact us.

App: RunPad
Developer: Labs Dev Apps
Email: labsdevapps@gmail.com

Privacy Policy for Colap Mobile
Last updated: November 19, 2026
Colap Mobile (“we”, “our”, or “us”), developed by Labs Dev Apps, is a lightweight Android app that lets you use Google Colab on your phone like an app. This Privacy Policy explains what information is collected, how it is used, and the choices you have when you use Colap Mobile.
By installing or using the app, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the app.
Colap Mobile is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Google LLC. “Google” and “Colab” are trademarks of Google LLC.
1. Information We Collect
Labs Dev Apps does not operate its own servers for this app, does not offer user accounts, and does not collect, store, or sell your personal information. The information described below is handled on your device or by the third-party services listed in this policy.
Google Colab and your Google Account: The app displays Google Colab (colab.research.google.com) inside an in-app browser (WebView). When you sign in, you do so on Google’s own pages. Your Google credentials, notebooks, code, and data are processed by Google under Google’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. We never see or store your Google password.
Data stored on your device: The app keeps your session (cookies and web storage) and your preferences on your device, such as the last notebook opened, recent notebooks, theme, text size, language, custom shortcut keys, menu position, app lock setting, and ad-free timer. This data stays on your device and is not sent to us.
Files you choose: The app can access a file only when you pick it with the file picker or share it to the app. Files you download from Colab are saved to your device’s Downloads folder. We do not upload or read these files for any other purpose.
Advertising data: The app shows ads through Google AdMob. AdMob may collect and use your device’s advertising ID, IP address, device and app information, and ad interaction data to serve, measure, and limit ads, and to prevent fraud. See Section 5 for details.
2. Google Colab and External Services
Colab integration: Colap Mobile is a wrapper around the Colab website. Links that leave Colab or Google sign-in may open in your default browser or another app.
Your responsibility: You use Google Colab with your own Google Account. We do not manage, control, or take responsibility for your account, notebooks, code you run, resources used, or data created on Google Colab.
Disclaimer: Your use of Google Colab is at your own risk and subject to Google’s terms. Labs Dev Apps is not liable for account suspension, resource limits, data loss, or other damages arising from your use of Google Colab or other external services.
3. Permissions Used
Internet and network state: To load Google Colab, reconnect automatically, and show an offline page when there is no connection.
Notifications: To show download actions and, if you turn it on, notifications about finished cells or lost connections.
Foreground service and wake lock: To keep your Colab connection alive in the background and keep the screen on, only when you enable these options.
Advertising ID: Used by Google AdMob for advertising and analytics, as described in Section 5. You can reset or delete your advertising ID in your Android settings.
4. How We Use Information
Information handled by the app is used only for the following purposes:
• To display Google Colab and provide the app’s features, such as downloads, file upload, shortcut bar, themes, and app lock.
• To remember your settings and resume where you left off.
• To show, measure, and limit advertising through Google AdMob, and to give you ad-free time when you watch rewarded ads.
• To keep the app secure and working properly.
5. Third-Party Services
The app uses the following third-party services, which have their own privacy policies:
• Google AdMob and Google Mobile Ads SDK (advertising): policies.google.com/technologies/ads
• Google User Messaging Platform (consent messages for users in the EEA, UK, and other regions): policies.google.com/privacy
• Google Play services (app distribution and services): policies.google.com/privacy
• Google Colab and Google Accounts (the service displayed in the app): policies.google.com/privacy
6. Advertising Choices and Consent
If you are in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another region that requires consent, the app shows a consent message from Google before personalized ads are served, and you can change your choice later. On Android, you can also reset your advertising ID or opt out of ad personalization in Settings > Google > Ads. Rewarded ads are optional; watching 10 rewarded ads gives 30 minutes without ads.
7. Data Retention and Deletion
We do not keep your data on our own servers, so there is nothing for us to delete on our side. Data stored by the app on your device can be removed at any time by using the “Sign out” option in the app menu, clearing the app’s storage in Android settings, or uninstalling the app. Data held by Google (your Google Account, Colab, and advertising data) is managed through your Google Account settings at myaccount.google.com.
8. Data Security
The app uses HTTPS connections only, does not allow cleartext traffic, and has automatic backups disabled. You can also turn on the optional app lock, which uses your device’s screen-lock authentication and hides app content from screenshots and recent apps. No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.
9. Children’s Privacy
Colap Mobile is not directed to children under 13 (or under 16 where local law requires). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided personal information through the app, please contact us and we will help resolve it.
10. Your Privacy Rights
Depending on where you live (for example, the EEA, the UK, or California), you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or restrict the use of your personal data, and to withdraw consent. Because we do not collect or store your personal data ourselves, these requests mostly concern Google and its services, which you can manage through your Google Account and Android settings. You may also contact us with any privacy question.
11. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The updated version will be posted at this same link and in our store listing, with a new “Last updated” date. Continued use of the app after a change means you accept the updated policy.
12. Contact Us
If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us:
Developer name: Labs Dev Apps
Email: labsdevapps@gmail.com
Website: https://labsdevappsweb.github.io

Privacy Policy for WebToApp
Last updated: November 19, 2026
WebToApp ("the App", "we", "us") is developed by Labs Dev Apps. This policy explains what information the App handles and how. If you have questions, contact us at labsdevapps@gmail.com.
1. Summary
WebToApp works on your device. It does not require an account, and we do not run a server that receives your projects, files or personal data.
2. Information we collect
We do not collect, store or receive personal information through the App. Specifically:
No account or registration is needed.
Your project files (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images, fonts, ZIP files, icons, splash files) are processed on your device only. They are not uploaded to us.
Your app settings, keystores (.p12 / .pfx), passwords and generated APK or AAB files stay on your device. We cannot access them.
3. Permissions the App may request
Storage / file access: to let you pick project files, icons and keystores, and to save APK and AAB files to your Downloads folder.
Install packages: to open the Android install screen for a test APK that you built.
Internet access: used when you load a web address in the built-in preview or test, and for any web content you choose to open.
The App uses these permissions only for the features you start. Permissions are not used to collect personal data.
4. Apps you create with WebToApp
WebToApp can build Android apps from websites or HTML projects, and can add features such as AdMob ads, camera, microphone or location access.
You are the developer and publisher of the apps you create. You are responsible for their content, permissions, ads, data collection and for providing your own privacy policy, as required by Google Play and applicable law.
If you enable AdMob in an app you build, that app will use Google's advertising services, which may collect device identifiers and other data under Google's policies. See https://policies.google.com/privacy.
We do not receive any data from the apps you create.
5. Third-party services
The App itself does not share your data with third parties. Websites you load inside a WebView or preview are operated by third parties and have their own privacy practices.
6. Data security
Because your data stays on your device, its security depends mainly on your device. Keep your keystore and its password safe. We cannot recover them, and you need them to update your apps on Google Play.
7. Data retention and deletion
We do not hold your data. To remove all App data from your device, clear the App's storage or uninstall it. Files you saved to Downloads (APK, AAB, .p12 backups) remain until you delete them.
8. Children's privacy
The App is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone, including children.
9. Your rights
Since we do not collect or store personal data, there is no personal data for us to access, correct or delete. If you believe we hold information about you, contact us and we will respond promptly. Depending on where you live (for example under GDPR or CCPA), you may have additional rights, which you can exercise by contacting us.
10. Changes to this policy
We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version will always be available on this page, with the "Last updated" date changed.
11. Contact
WebToApp
Email: labsdevapps@gmail.com
Google Play, Android and AdMob are trademarks of Google LLC.

apps.policy_text:
## Privacy Policy – AI App Forge

**Last updated:** November 18, 2026
**Developer:** Labs Dev Apps
**App:** AI App Forge (`com.labsdevapps.aiappforge`)
**Contact:** labsdevapps@gmail.com

### 1. Overview
AI App Forge lets you turn HTML code into an Android APK or AAB directly on your device. This policy explains what information the app handles and how. We do not run user accounts and we do not operate a server that collects your data.

### 2. Information we do not collect
We do not require registration. We do not collect your name, email address, location, contacts, photos or any other personal information, and we do not send the HTML code, files, icons or apps you create to our servers. Building, signing and packaging happen on your device.

### 3. Data stored on your device
The app stores some data locally on your device only:
- Settings and preferences, such as language and ad-free time remaining.
- Signing keys and signing settings used to sign the apps you build.
- Files you add to a project, and the APK/AAB files you generate.

This data stays on your device. Uninstalling the app or clearing its data removes it.

### 4. Clipboard
The app reads the clipboard only when you ask it to, for example to paste HTML code. The app may also copy text to the clipboard, such as a prompt or an email address. Clipboard contents are not sent to us.

### 5. Internet access
The app uses the internet for two purposes:
- To show ads (see section 6).
- To download external resources (scripts, stylesheets, images) that your HTML refers to, so they can be bundled into your app. These requests go directly from your device to the address in your code. We do not see them.

### 6. Advertising
The app shows ads provided by Google AdMob (Google Mobile Ads SDK). Google and its partners may collect and use device identifiers (such as the Android advertising ID), IP address, and ad-interaction data to serve and measure ads and to prevent fraud. Where required, such as in the EEA and the UK, the app asks for your consent through Google's User Messaging Platform (UMP) before showing personalized ads.

You can manage ad personalization in your device's Settings (Google > Ads), and learn more in Google's policies at https://policies.google.com/privacy and https://policies.google.com/technologies/ads.

The app offers an option to watch ads in exchange for a period without ads. Watching ads is always optional.

### 7. Permissions
- **Internet:** to show ads and fetch resources referenced in your code.
- **Notifications:** to show build or status notifications.
- **Vibration:** for haptic feedback.
- **Install packages:** only so you can install the APK you built. Installation always requires your confirmation.

### 8. Feedback by email
If you choose "Send feedback", the app opens your email app with a message addressed to labsdevapps@gmail.com. We receive only what you choose to send. We use it only to respond to you and improve the app.

### 9. Apps you create
Apps you build with AI App Forge are your own. You are responsible for their content, for their own privacy policy, and for complying with the laws and store policies that apply to them. If you add ads or other SDKs to your apps, you must disclose that in their privacy policy.

### 10. Sharing of information
We do not sell your personal information. The only third party that processes data through the app is Google, through the advertising services described in section 6.

### 11. Children
AI App Forge is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

### 12. Security
Your data stays on your device. We rely on the security of your device and of Android to protect it, so please keep your device and your signing keys safe.

### 13. Changes to this policy
We may update this policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date above will change when we do. Continued use of the app means you accept the updated policy.

### 14. Contact
For questions or requests about this policy, email **labsdevapps@gmail.com**.
